stem: Freshly rooted cuttings wilt shortly after a rapid reduction in humidity. Which response best fits Technician I scope?
choices: Document the response and follow the supplied acclimatization procedure or escalation path
Assume the roots are nonfunctional and discard the entire batch
Return every batch to maximum humidity indefinitely
rationale: Rooted cuttings often need gradual acclimatization; technicians should follow the defined transition plan rather than improvise a new protocol.
